title: The Birthday Paradox - Probability Simulations in PHP
author: Stefan Bogdanescu
excerpt: Explore the birthday paradox through Monte Carlo simulations in PHP. Learn how 23 people yield a 50% chance of a shared birthday, with practical applications in cryptography and hashing.
